Dear Ms Fen,

Thank you for your messages about parcel VEL-021-26 from Marigold Books.

I'm sorry, but I can't confirm that your parcel is lost, and I can't arrange a refund today. Opening an investigation doesn't mean the parcel has been found to be lost. It means our trace team is now looking for it. The investigation (reference TR-021) was opened at 08:00 BST on 14 October. It is still open and has no result yet. Our records show the parcel was last scanned at our Cress depot at 18:20 BST on 12 October.

The trace team's next review is due at 12:00 BST on 15 October. Refunds are decided by Marigold Books customer care, not by us. They make that decision based on the investigation result. I'll check the investigation at that time and write to you with whatever it shows. No action is needed from you now.

Please note this message is an update, not a confirmation of loss or of any refund.

Kind regards,
Rivet Delivery Desk
